Development and validation of robotic probe holder device for ultrasound-guided central venous canulation (Project Code- D644)

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) is a medical institute at Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029. This post is in its Neuroanaesthesiology and Critical Care Department. It serves a DST-funded project to develop and validate a robotic probe holder device for ultrasound-guided central venous canulation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following essential qualification for the SRF (Senior Research Fellow) post: (i) Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, with the candidate selected through any one of the following processes: (ii) a. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE; OR (ii) b. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. (iii) Experience of at least 2 year in the field Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course. The Hindi version of the notice says this is at least 2 years of experience in the related field after obtaining that degree. The age limit is as per DST norms. The notice states that all age limit and experience criteria will be as per DST guidelines. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The SRF (Senior Research Fellow) is engaged on a contractual/adhoc basis under the DST-funded project (Project Code- D644), which runs till 21-03-2027. The salary is as per DST norms, and the notice states that all salaries will be as per DST guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi SRF (Senior Research Fellow)
content_sections.text: Prepare your Curriculum Vitae (CV). Email the CV to [email protected] . In the subject of the email, write the name of the post: SRF (Senior Research Fellow). Send the email by 7 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications submitted after that will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The applications will be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview, and the invitation will come by email. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, and applications received after the due date, will not be entertained. Before applying, check that you meet the educational qualification, the NET/GATE or other national-level examination requirement and the minimum 2 years of experience (from the Hindi version of the notice).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026 for SRF?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for SRF (Senior Research Fellow). It is in the DST-funded project of the Neuroanaesthesiology and Critical Care Department at AIIMS, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS New Delhi SRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 7 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications submitted after that will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AIIMS New Delhi SRF post?
faq.answer: You need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science, or a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course.
